none: PAS LVPL-0FCB3C: Roman base silver coin: radiate of Postumus
contea di ritrovamento: Nottinghamshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ is IMP C POSTVMVS PF AVG ; R/ is PAX AVG

A Roman base silver radiate of Postumus dating to the period AD 260 to 269 (Reece Period 13). Reverse type PAX AVG Pax standing left holding branch and transverse sceptre. Cf Cun p145, no 2453. Principal mint of Gaul. The diameter is 20mm, and the weight is 2.5g. Obverse inscription is IMP C POSTVMVS PF AVG and the reverse inscription is PAX AVG
